say:1:1123504001:1.text: I thought I already made it pretty clear last time. It's important that we follow our traditions.
say:1:1123504001:1.source_cn: 我以为上次的对话能让你明白，遵循传统是必要的。

say:2:1123504002:1.text: What are you doing here?! Are you here to watch me suffer as I follow traditions?! To humiliate me?!
say:2:1123504002:1.source_cn: 你现在来做什么？来看我遵循传统的结果并羞辱我吗？

say:3:1123504003:1.text: None of us came with ill will. I just hope that you will return to where you belong. That is all.
say:3:1123504003:1.source_cn: 没人是带着恶意来的。\n我只是希望你能回到属于自己的地...

say:4:1123504004:1.text: I already am where I belong. These old bones will turn to dust and return to the desert.
say:4:1123504004:1.source_cn: 我已经回到自己所属之地，并将化为沙漠中的白骨。

say:5:1123504005:1.text: Besides... I like it here. There was once an ironjaw that lived and died here. We share the same fate.
say:5:1123504005:1.source_cn: 我很中意这里。这里曾有只钢颚兽并埋骨于此，多么相称的终途。

choice_prompt:6:1123504005.text: Besides... I like it here. There was once an ironjaw that lived and died here. We share the same fate.
choice_prompt:6:1123504005.source_cn: 我很中意这里。这里曾有只钢颚兽并埋骨于此，多么相称的终途。

say:7:1123504006:1.text: That's not for you to decide, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:7:1123504006:1.male: That's not for you to decide, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:7:1123504006:1.female: That's not for you to decide, <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:8:1123504007:1.text: But Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. We'll only end up like Orson if we value power above all else...
say:8:1123504007:1.male: But Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. We'll only end up like Orson if we value power above all else...
say:8:1123504007:1.female: But Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. We'll only end up like Orson if we value power above all else...

say:9:1123504009:1.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族需要你的智慧，哈什尔。

say:10:1123504010:1.text: Please come back with us. Many young warriors in our clan need your knowledge and insight... someone to help guide the next generation.
say:10:1123504010:1.source_cn: 跟我们回去吧，氏族内有太多需要教化的年轻人，我们需要更...

say:11:1123504011:1.text: I understand, but having too many elders can be a burden to a clan.
say:11:1123504011:1.source_cn: 你们所说的的确有些道理，但过多的老者是种拖累。

say:12:1123504012:1.text: Traditions should not be followed if they bind those who can help. You could do much more for the clan than you realize.
say:12:1123504012:1.source_cn: 老旧的传统不能束缚住有能力的人，你原本可以为氏族做更多的事。

say:13:1123504013:1.text: What you say does make sense, but it's too late now. I've already announced my exile. I must stand by my words.
say:13:1123504013:1.source_cn: 即便你说的有道理，一切都太迟了，我已经宣言过自我放逐，...

say:16:1123504015:1.text: Although he hasn't decided to return, his thoughts waver. Our conversation today gives me hope.
say:16:1123504015:1.source_cn: 虽然他没有回到氏族，但他似乎有所动摇。今天的谈话让我看...

say:18:1123504008:1.text: So? That has nothing to do with me.
